detail.longDescription: Where do you start with 17 million (although now it has been significantly shortened) lines of Lean code? I started at the end and tried to work backward. I used Robin Zhang’s notes （ https://hexagonmath.org/pdf/2611.00809v2） to build a map where you can pick a step and see which earlier results it uses, with links to the papers and Lean code. I have no idea if this interactive map actually works, and my major is not in math. It is just my personal attempt. Look forward to your feedback.
